messages:
anya: Ran onboarding bench for Mercury48k-int3q on dedicated node pool. Warmstart with 64k prefills + interleaved user prepends. Observed fidelity drop ~1.8% BLEU-like metric after ~12k generated tokens.

kartik: Can you paste the repro prompt + the exact prefill sequence?

anya: Short one: system prompt + 3 user messages (varying lengths). Prefill script: ```python
# prefill harness
for msg in seed_msgs:
    client.generate(model='mercury-48k-int3q', prompt=msg, max_new_tokens=0, prefill=True)
``` 

mira: Did you use KV warmstart handshake or streaming prefill? we saw differences earlier.

anya: Warmstart handshake (blocking prefill to populate KV shards) then regular streaming generation.

evan: Can you attach the small log snippet where the divergence appears? maybe rot-phase scaling mismatch.

anya: pasted log lines:
```
[12:04:02] PREFILL shard=2 seq=12000 ok
[12:04:08] PREFILL shard=2 handshake=complete
[12:04:09] GENERATE token=12001 kv_index=12000
[12:04:10] WARN kv-fingerprint-mismatch shard=2 expected=0x9f2a got=0x9f20
[12:04:10] GENERATE token=12002 -> token mismatch @prob=0.7
```

samir: kv-fingerprint-mismatch is interesting. Could be quantized index truncation. Which quant backend? int3q uses our new blockpack v2.

anya: blockpack v2, kernel set = fast_fp32-emul. I ran float baseline on same prompt and no mismatch.

mira: Hypothesis: RoPE phase scaling applied pre/post-quantization inconsistent across prefill and live tokenization path. If prefill uses dense rotate path and generate uses fused-rotary with quant-friendly rescale we could see off-by-phase.

kartik: Quick check: try running prefill with streaming mode (no handshake) and compare kv fingerprint. If difference goes away maybe handshake path isn't applying scale factor.

anya: spinning a quick run now. will post KV fingerprints.

benchbot: scheduled bench run 1781234999 on node g1-dedicated-8

anya: run done. streaming-prefill run log:
```
[12:19:01] PREFILL streaming shard=2 seq=12000 ok
[12:19:02] GENERATE token=12001 kv_index=12000
[12:19:02] OK kv-fingerprint shard=2 0x9f2a
[12:19:03] GENERATE token=12002 -> matches baseline
```

evan: So handshake path seems to mutate/omit a phase-rescale step. Can you open the handshake trace in /var/logs/mercury/kvcache/handshake-1781234567.log and grep for apply_rotary_scale? 

anya: grep shows no apply_rotary_scale in handshake trace.

samir: That matches. Prefill handshake likely uses legacy path for speed. Quick fix: add explicit phase rescale in handshake for int3q models. Long term: unify kernel selection.

mira: Also add unit test that compares kv-fingerprint between prefill modes for quantized models.

anya: I'll file PR for handshake patch + unit test. Assign to @samir for review. Will re-run full 24h stress after merge.

kartik: Thanks. Add a note to the onboarding checklist for Mercury48k-int3q about handshake compatibility.

anya: done. PR: rwood/mercury#452

mira: :thumbsup: good catch — this explains intermittent long-context regressions in dedicated envs.

benchbot: regression alert suppressed until PR lands. scheduled rebench at 1781320000
